meta.title: Wohlauf · Physiotherapy in Hannover-Südstadt
meta.description: Physiotherapy in Hannover's Südstadt, four minutes from the Maschsee. Statutory and private insurance, or without a prescription. With a mobility check for your phone.
meta.checkDescription: In 90 seconds your phone measures how far your neck, shoulders and trunk move.

goals.sub: From the first easy kilometre to a full lap of the Maschsee: we build the load back up step by step.
When a shoulder or your back wakes you at night, we look for the cause and show you positions that take the pressure off.
Lifting, carrying, nursing: we get your back and shoulders ready for everyday life.
Eight hours at a desk is a lot. We release what is stiff and give you exercises that fit into a coffee break.
After knee or hip surgery we stay with you from the first step to the third floor.
Shoulder, elbow, ankle: we get you back on court and test how much load it takes.

check.title: Your phone is a goniometer.
check.p: Physiotherapists measure joints in degrees. The sensors in your phone can do that too. In 90 seconds you see how far your neck, shoulders and trunk move, left compared with right.
check.desktop: Works best on a phone. On a computer you set the angles by hand.
check.note: A rough guide, not a diagnosis. The readings stay on your device.

hilfe.title: What we help with
hilfe.p: The most common reasons people come to us.

items.typisch: Pain after long sitting, stiff in the morning, radiating into an arm or leg.
items.wir: Examine spine and hips, mobilise joints, strengthen the trunk, talk through your desk setup.

items.typisch: Pain when dressing, reaching overhead and at night lying on that side.
items.wir: Include shoulder blade and upper back, widen the range step by step, strengthen the rotator cuff.

items.typisch: Pain on the first steps, going downstairs, after load.
items.wir: Check leg alignment and strength, build up specifically, dose the load so the joint keeps up.

items.s: Cruciate ligament, joint replacement, shoulder, disc
items.typisch: Swelling, limited bending or straightening, feeling unsure under load.
items.wir: Follow your surgeon's protocol, document progress in degrees, write a report for your check-up.

items.typisch: Pain from a certain kilometre, after speed work or the morning after.
items.wir: Video running analysis, strength and jump tests, a training plan with clear stages back to sport.
items.rezept: KG, running analysis as a self-pay service

items.typisch: Clicking, clenching at night, pain in front of the ear, headache coming from the neck.
items.wir: Look at jaw, neck and posture together, relax the muscles, home exercises.
items.rezept: KG or MT, often prescribed by a dentist

q: Rehab after knee and hip surgery

room: Three treatment rooms, one training room
Tram stop Geibelstraße, 3 minutes on foot

items.a: No. With a prescription we bill your statutory or private insurer. Without one you come directly to Ronja Dreesen as a self-pay patient; her sectoral Heilpraktiker licence for physiotherapy allows treatment without a doctor's prescription.

items.q: What do I bring to the first visit?
items.a: Your prescription, your insurance card, any doctor's letters or scans, and comfortable clothes. We have a towel for you.

items.q: How soon can I get an appointment?
items.a: That depends on the week. The next free first visit is shown at the top of the page. After surgery or with acute complaints please call, and we will try to make something possible.
With a prescription the length follows the prescription. For self-pay patients we offer 30, 45 and 60 minutes; we recommend 60 minutes for the first visit so there is time for the assessment.

items.q: I need to cancel. What now?
items.a: Please cancel at least 24 hours ahead, by phone or e-mail. We charge for appointments missed at short notice because we can no longer give the time to someone else.

items.q: What does the mobility check measure?
items.a: The orientation sensors in your phone measure how far you move your head, arm and upper body. The values are accurate to about 5 to 10 degrees and do not replace an assessment. They stay on your device until you attach them to a request yourself.

app.title: Mobility check
app.introP: You hold the phone to your forehead, in your hand and on your chest. The orientation sensors measure the angle. Move slowly and only as far as feels good.
introList: Neck: turn your head left and right
Shoulders: raise your arm forwards and up
app.manualAuto: This device reports no orientation sensors. You can set the angles by hand.
app.denied: Without access to the motion sensors the phone cannot measure. You can set the angles by hand.
app.safety: Do not move into pain. Stop if you feel dizzy. Skip this check after surgery or an accident.
app.privacy: Measured on your device only. Nothing is transmitted.

tests.how: Phone upright against your forehead, screen facing forwards. Sit tall.
tests.do: Slowly turn your head left, back to the middle, then right. Keep your shoulders still.
tests.end: Then take the phone down or tap Done.
tests.manualQ: How far does your head turn?

tests.how: Phone firmly in your hand, arm hanging loose. Left first, then right.
tests.do: Slowly raise your straight arm forwards and up as far as it goes, then lower it.
tests.end: Arm down: tap Done, then the other side.
tests.manualQ: How high do you raise your arm?

tests.how: Phone upright and flat against your breastbone, screen facing forwards. Feet hip-width apart.
tests.do: Slowly bend your upper body left, back to the middle, then right. Do not tip forwards.
tests.manualQ: How far do you bend sideways?

app.resultP: This is how far you moved today. A difference between left and right is often the most interesting value.
app.uneven: A clear difference between left and right. We look at that specifically in the assessment.
app.disclaimer: A rough guide, not a diagnosis. Values are accurate to about 5 to 10°. The ranges come from the neutral-zero method and apply to healthy adults; age and build change them.
app.send: Request a visit with this result
app.sendNote: The values are only attached in the form with your consent.
